name: Quakerwoods Campground
note: Part seasonal: seasonal and monthly sites share the wooded loops with nightly campers (roughly half the pads held stored trailers in a February 2020 leaf-off capture); open April 1 - October 31, reservations by phone only. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: quakerwoods.com rates/map/events pages (read 2026-10-21): 2026 nightly rates for 30A W/E and full-hookup RV sites plus week/month/season rates, ~170 numbered RV sites (30/50A, pull-thrus) on the 2026 site map, season April 1-Oct 31, phone reservations; RV Life reviewers paid nightly rates on stays May-Sep 2026 and Campendium logs a 26-ft rig 7/2026 with 50-ft max site -> real transient RV campground passing long-stay tests 2-5 (nightly rate + phone, no application for nights, 2-night standing minimum, transient share well over 1 in 10 by leaf-off imagery, no homes or lots sold); price gate lifted: within 40 km of a family home (gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-10-21: only water is a small (~50x60 m) fishing pond by the Rosedale Rd entrance plus a creek lined by tent-only sites (operator 2026 map). Esri imagery at 40.4680,-75.3994 (current leaf-on, and Wayback 2020-02-03 leaf-off z19) shows the pond ringed by mowed lawn and a treeline, with no RV pad at its shore; nearest trailers ~80 m south behind trees. Default down -> not waterfront.
fees_source: https://quakerwoods.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/rates-2026-3.jpg (2026 rate table on quakerwoods.com/rates/, read 2026-10-21): Water & Electric (30 Amp) $54/day, Full Hookup (30 Amp) $60/day for 2 adults + 2 children; 50 Amp / pull-through +$5/day optional; holiday weekends flat 3-day rates; no mandatory resort fee ($2 card convenience fee avoidable with debit)
booking_source: https://quakerwoods.com/rates/ (read 2026-10-21): '2 nights minimum required' with no weekend qualifier; https://quakerwoods.com/events/: Memorial Day, 4th of July and Labor Day weekends '(3 Night Minimum)'
flags: 2-night minimum recorded as standing ('always') because the rates page states it unqualified; a Campendium reviewer stayed '2 night midweek' (2021), consistent with it, but whether a single weeknight is sold by phone is unconfirmed - could be weekend-only in practice.

Seasonal share is an estimate from counting stored trailers on a 0.46 m leaf-off capture (Feb 2020, roughly 80 units vs ~170 RV sites); no site count anywhere splits seasonal from transient. Reviewers note 'a lot of permanent campsites' (Campendium 2021) and RV Life's summary says 'a mix of seasonal and short-term guests'.
Booking is phone only (no online engine); the site carries current 2026 prices and phone, which satisfies the presence rule.
